source.snippet: Is there any way to setup a Salesforce project in VSCode so that Apex Language Server can jump to definition for a project with multiple Unlocked Packages in different namespaces? I installed SOQLLib and DMLLib which are both namespaced to btcdev. I retrieved the source code of the unlocked packages into their own folders. The problem is that their source code isn't namespaced. So in my Apex without a namespace, I have to use btcdev.DML.logger but jump to definition only works without the namespace prefix.

problem_statement: Salesforce developers working across multiple Unlocked Packages in different namespaces cannot use Apex Language Server's jump-to-definition in VSCode, blocking standard IDE navigation in enterprise multi-package projects.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and ISVs managing multi-namespace Unlocked Package projects at mid-to-large companies.
notes: Single recent signal (2026-09-15) but in a paid enterprise ecosystem — Salesforce licenses are expensive and developers working on multi-namespace Unlocked Packages are definitively in a commercial context. Pain is concrete and reproducible. Opportunity: a VSCode extension or Apex LSP patch that correctly resolves namespaced references across multi-package SFDX projects. Low competition, niche but high-value buyer segment.
